# slideit

> Presentations whose code transitions are animated by an AST diff (GumTree). A deck is a folder of `.slide` files
> (one file = one slide, written in tags) plus an optional deck.json. It compiles to a static
> website, a single HTML file, a PDF or a standalone executable. Everything you need to write a deck is below; the full
> manual is in llms-full.txt (same site) and in the README: https://github.com/geraldserafin/md-slides

## How to produce a deck (for an LLM)

1. Make a folder `my-talk/`. Put one slide per `.slide` file; slides play in file-name order, so number them:
   `01-cover.slide`, `02-problem.slide`, `03-demo.slide` ...
2. Optionally add `deck.json` (title, theme, author, footer ...), images and videos next to the slides.
3. Run `npx slideit dev my-talk/` (live reload) or `npx slideit build my-talk/ -o dist` (static site),
   `--target single` (one .html), `--target pdf`, `--target exe`. A folder of deck folders becomes a chooser page.
4. Write for the audience: one idea per slide, short text, code that changes in small steps.

## The markup

Tags only, no Markdown. Tags are strict: an unknown tag, a missing closing tag or text outside a tag is an error with the line
number. Attributes: `key=value` (quote values with spaces), a bare word is a flag (`autoplay`), a tag without content ends with
`/>`. The content of `<code> <c> <tex> <chart> <diagram> <notes> <slide>` is raw (no escaping of `<` or `&`; common indentation
removed; write `\</code>` for a closing tag as text). In text tags write `&lt;` for `<`.

```text
<slide>
  layout: cover          # optional settings, one key: value per line
</slide>

<h1>Title</h1>
<p>Text, <b>bold</b>, <c>code</c>, <tex>x^2</tex> math.</p>
<ul><li>a list</li><li>of points</li></ul>

<notes>Presenter notes (press p).</notes>
```

| Tag | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `<slide>` | settings of the slide (below) |
| `<section>` | one of several parts of a slide, played one after another with → (whatever is outside the sections stays on screen; without any, the slide is one section) |
| `<row>` | children side by side, equal shares (`size=2` weight, `size=auto`, `size=40%`); also `halign` `valign` |
| `<col>` | children stacked (use it to put several things into one part of a row) |
| `<step at=N>` | content appears on the next click (or on click N) |
| `<h1> <h2> <h3> <p> <quote>` | headings, paragraphs, quotes (each one is an item; `size` `halign` `valign` work as on a col) |
| `<ul> <ol>` + `<li>` | lists; `steps` shows a list bullet by bullet |
| `<table>` + `<tr> <th> <td>` | a table |
| inline: `<b> <i> <s> <c> <a href> <kbd> <mark> <sub> <sup> <br />` | `<c>` is code (raw) |
| `<tex>` | math (KaTeX): inline in a `<p>`, display on its own |
| `<code lang=ts id=x>` | animated code, with `<frame>`s (below) |
| `<img src=a.png class="left" width=40% />`, `<video .../>`, `<audio .../>` | media; `autoplay loop muted` |
| `<chart type=bar title="T">`CSV`</chart>` | chart from CSV (first row names the series); `type=bar|line|pie`, `width` |
| `<diagram>`mermaid`</diagram>` | Mermaid diagram |
| `<notes>` | presenter notes |

Rows and columns nest, and the parts always add up to the whole slide:

```text
<h2>Title</h2>
<row>
  <col>
    <h3>Left</h3>
    <p>Text</p>
  </col>
  <code lang=ts>...</code>      <!-- a row's children are its parts -->
</row>
```

Any tag with content takes animation attributes: `anim` (fade|rise|zoom|left|right|down|blur|pop|none), `delay`, `dur`
(seconds), `at=N` (the click it appears), `out=N` (the click it disappears) and `id=name` (morph: the same id in the next
section or slide glides between the two; same-file images do it automatically).

## Animated code (the point of the tool)

A `<code>` is one block and its `<frame>`s are the states it passes through: the first is shown with the block, each next
one takes a click, and the code morphs between them (tokens glide, new ones fade in, removed ones fade out).

```text
<code lang=ts>
  <frame>
    const total = items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.price, 0);
  </frame>
  <frame focus=1>
    const total = items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0);
  </frame>
</code>
```

Blocks are independent unless they share an `id`: the same `id` in another section or slide continues the animation.
`<code from=cart />` copies the last frame of the earlier block with that id. Attributes of `<code>`: `lang`, `id`,
`size=18`, `class="lines panel left right top middle bottom"`, `start=10`, `title=cart.ts`, `bg=#16213e`, `radius=12`,
`pad="1em"`, `halign`/`valign`, `fit=none`, `at=N`, `autoplay=1` (frames play by themselves, seconds apart, taking no clicks) with `loop`; of `<frame>`: `focus=2-4,7` (dim the other lines), `transition=morph|fade|none`
(how this frame is entered), `at=N`. Languages: typescript/ts, tsx, javascript/js, python/py, rust, go, java, c, cpp, bash, json,
html, css, lua. Between two different languages the code cross-fades. A language without a grammar is a plain static block.

## Slide settings (in `<slide>`)

`layout: cover`, `theme: light|dark|paper|<yours>`, `background: img.jpg | #123 | linear-gradient(...) | clip.mp4`,
`halign`/`valign: start|center|end` (default start/start), `justify: true`, `transition: fade|slide|slide-right|slide-left|zoom|none`,
`section-transition: ...` (between sections), `heading-size`, `text-size`, `spacing`, `margin`, `gap`, `class`,
`footer: off`, `hidden: true` (skip the slide), `autoplay: 5`, any CSS variable `--accent: #f00`.

## deck.json

```json
{
  "title": "My talk", "author": "Me", "date": "2026-01-01",
  "theme": "dark",
  "schemes": { "light": "ink", "dark": "midnight" },
  "themes": { "ink": { "--bg": "#fbfaf6", "--fg": "#2b2e36", "--heading": "#11131a", "--accent": "#3a5ba0", "--code-bg": "#f1eee6" } },
  "fonts": [{ "family": "Source Sans 3", "src": "fonts/ss3.woff2", "weight": "400" }],
  "defaults": { "halign": "start", "justify": "true" },
  "header": { "left": "logo.svg", "right": "{title}" },
  "footer": { "left": "My talk", "right": "{slide} / {slides}", "height": 48 },
  "animation": { "move": 0.45, "fade": 0.3, "textTransition": "fade" },
  "code": { "bg": "panel", "lines": false, "radius": 10, "pad": "0.9em 1.1em" },
  "autoplay": 5, "loop": true, "hidden": false
}
```

Theme variables: `--bg --fg --heading --muted --accent --code-bg` and token colors `--tok-keyword --tok-ident
--tok-property --tok-type --tok-builtin --tok-comment --tok-punct --tok-plain`.

## Chooser page (a folder of decks)

`hub.json` next to the deck folders: `title`, `subtitle`, `logo`, `footer`, `links`, `theme`, `schemes`, `themes`,
`fonts`, `vars`, `css`, `align`, `cardWidth`, `show`, `order`, `colorToggle`.

## Keys while presenting

→ Space next · ← back · o slide drawer · p presenter window (notes, timer, next slide) · f fullscreen · t theme ·
l laser · d draw · z magnifier · b black screen · a autoplay · h help.
